recipes.purpose: Introduce one promise with a restrained visual anchor.
recipes.structure: 12-column canvas; title occupies columns 1–8, one cropped motif occupies 9–12.

recipes.purpose: Reset the rhythm and name the next chapter or question.
recipes.structure: Large chapter marker crosses a single color field; supporting copy remains narrow.

recipes.purpose: Make one sentence or conclusion impossible to miss.
recipes.structure: Statement owns the visual center; support sits on a narrow lower rail.

recipes.purpose: Pair a conclusion-led narrative with one evidence or implication zone.
recipes.structure: Asymmetric 7:5 or 8:4 grid; avoid nested cards and dashboard chrome.

recipes.purpose: Explain exactly three parallel ideas with clear visual hierarchy.
recipes.structure: Three anchors share a baseline but do not look like dashboard cards.

recipes.purpose: Contrast two states and converge on one implication.
recipes.structure: Two evidence fields share a baseline and lead into a single answer band.

recipes.purpose: Show a finite sequence with outputs rather than decorative arrows.
recipes.structure: Connected steps follow one reading path; each step contains action and output.

recipes.purpose: Explain change over time with milestones and consequences.
recipes.structure: Milestones align to one axis; labels alternate to protect whitespace.

recipes.purpose: Make one source-backed metric the visual anchor and explain its meaning.
recipes.structure: One 140px metric or phrase dominates; supporting evidence remains secondary.

recipes.purpose: Resolve the opening question with one decision, action, or enduring message.
recipes.structure: Closing answer occupies the center; one next action anchors the lower edge.
